blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Different from natural videos, Screen Content Videos (SCVs) are characterized by abrupt motion, scene switches, and high-frequency details such as text and graphics. Conventional video enhancement methods, which rely heavily on temporal continuity, often suffer from performance degradation when processing SCVs due to the disruption of temporal correlations. To address these challenges, we propose the Spatial-Temporal Multi-scale Network (STM-Net), a novel framework specifically tailored for compressed SCV enhancement. Our approach integrates three complementary components: a Prior-Guided Spatio-Temporal Dispatcher (PG-STD) that routes input into three parallel streams to avoid feature contamination, a Bidirectional Temporal Feature Extraction (BTFE) module that adaptively handles abrupt transitions without explicit detection, and a Cascaded Multi-scale Feature Distillation (CMFD) module that preserves critical high-frequency details. Experimental results demonstrate that STM-Net outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both objective metrics and subjective visual quality, providing a robust solution for screen content artifacts. Code is available at https://github.com/HUANGZiyin1/STM-Net.
blocks.zh: 与自然视频不同,屏幕内容视频(SCV)的特点是突然移动,场景开关,以及文字和图形等高频细节. 常规视频增强方法严重依赖时间连续性,由于时间相关性的中断,在处理SCV时往往会出现性能退化. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立空间-时空多尺度网络(STM-Net),这是一个专门针对压缩SCV增强的新框架。 我们的方法包括三个相辅相成的组成部分:先导的Spatio-Temperation调度器(PG-STD),它引导输入到三个平行流流中以避免特征污染;双方向的Temperal Feature Inductionon(BTFE)模块,适应性地处理突发过渡而没有明确检测;以及Cascadded的多级地物消化模块,它保存关键高频细节. 实验结果显示,STM-Net在客观度量和主观视觉质量方面都优于最先进的方法,为屏幕内容文物提供了有力的解决方案. 代码见https://github.com/HUANGZiyin1/STM-Net。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: The rapid growth of cloud computing and remote collaboration has made Screen Content Video (SCV) transmission ubiquitous. Pre-COVID MOOCs and remote work drove demand for efficient coding of slides, code editors, and GUIs, amplified by pandemic videoconferencing and sustained in hybrid settings [ 1 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 云计算和远程协作的迅速发展使得Screen Content Video(SCV)的传输变得无处不在. COVID前MOOC和远程工作驱动了对幻灯片、代码编辑器和图形用户界面的有效编码需求,这种编码通过大流行视像会议加以放大,并在混合环境下持续 [1,2].

blocks.en: Various quality enhancement techniques have been proposed to improve visual fidelity for natural content [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] . However, unlike natural content, SCVs feature abrupt scene switches and computer-generated content, such as sharp edges, homogeneous regions, and repetitive patterns, which demands specialized compression like HEVC’s Screen Content Coding (SCC) [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] . Despite efficiency gains, compression artifacts such as blurring and ringing around text edges persist, severely impairing readability. Conventional enhancement methods fail due to abrupt motions (scrolling, scene switches) that disrupt temporal correlations where deep flow-based [ 13 ] or deformable convolution [ 14 ] approaches propagate errors from unrelated frames, leading to severe visual artifacts [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 提出了各种提高质量的技术,以提高自然内容的视觉可靠性[3、4、5、6、7]。 然而,与自然内容不同,SCVs的特点是突如其来的场景开关和计算机生成的内容,如尖锐的边缘,同质的区域,以及重复的模式,这需要像HEVC的Screen内容编码(SCC)那样的专业压缩[8,9,10,11,12]. 尽管提高了效率,但诸如文字边缘模糊和环绕等压缩文物依然存在,严重损害了可读性。 常规增强方法因突发运动(滚动、场景开关)而失效,这种运动中断了时间相关性,因为深流基 [13] 或可变形的演化 [14] 方法从不相关的框架传播错误,导致严重的视觉文物 [15] 。

blocks.en: Single‑frame methods [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] , such as IFCNN, VRCNN, DCAD, and QE-CNN, focus primarily on spatial information to restore compressed frames. These methods effectively exploit local cues but neglect temporal continuity, limiting their performance in video sequences.
blocks.zh: 单方框架方法[16,17,18,19,20],如IFCNN,VRCNN,DCAD,以及QE-CNN,主要侧重于空间信息以恢复压缩框架. 这些方法有效地利用了本地提示,但忽略了时间连续性,限制了其在视频序列中的性能.

blocks.en: Multi‑frame approaches [ 13 , 21 , 14 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 15 , 25 , 26 ] , such as MFQE [ 21 ] , rely on optical flow alignment, which is prone to errors in SCVs due to large, discontinuous displacements. Deformable convolution networks like STDF [ 14 ] and STDR [ 23 ] offer flexible alignment but struggle with scene switches where reference frames differ entirely. Recent SCV‑specific methods, including TGAF [ 24 ] and QECF [ 15 ] , introduce cross‑frame fusion. However, these methods typically process temporal data in a single stream, which risk feature contamination during scene switches.
blocks.zh: 多帧方法[13, 21, 14, 22, 23, 24, 15, 25, 26], 如MFQE [21] , 依靠光学流线对齐,由于大量不连续的迁移,在SCV中容易出错. STDF [14] 和STDR [23] 等可变变形的曲折网络提供了灵活的对齐,但与参考框架完全不同的场景开关发生斗争. 最近的SCV‐特定方法,包括TGAF[24]和QECF[15],引入跨框聚变. 然而,这些方法通常在单一流中处理时间数据,这有发生场景开关期间污染的危险。

blocks.en: To address these issues, we propose the Spatial-Temporal Multi-scale Network (STM-Net) to address temporal discontinuity and spatial high-frequency loss with three innovations: • Prior‑Guided Spatio‑Temporal Dispatcher (PG‑STD): PG‑STD acts as a feature dispatcher that route input frames to three parallel streams (preceding, succeeding, current frames) to prevent scene-cut contamination. • Bidirectional Temporal Feature Extraction (BTFE): Unlike single-stream methods, BTFE employs a dual-stream architecture with cross-connections to adaptively prioritize reliable temporal contexts, avoiding explicit scene detection. • Cascaded Multi-scale Feature Distillation (CMFD): To preserve fine details, CMFD employs a multi-branch architecture with multi-scale convolutions and channel attention mechanisms to distll multi-scale details in order to capture text strokes and structures while reducing over-smoothing.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立空间-时空多尺度网络(STM-Net),以解决时间不连续和空间高频损失问题,同时进行三项创新: · Preformed Spatio Temporal Expower(PGQSTD): PGQSTD 充当一个功能调度器,将输入帧传递到三个平行流(前、后继,当前帧),以防止现场污染。 • 双向临时地物提取法(BTFE): 与单流方法不同,BTFE采用了双流结构,具有交叉连接,以适应性地优先安排可靠的时间背景,避免明显的场景探测. • 连带多尺寸地物蒸馏: 为了保存精细的细节,CMFD采用了多分支架构,具有多尺度的演化,并引导注意力机制来分解多尺度的细节,以便捕捉文字中风和结构,同时减少过度的流畅.

blocks.en: Prior‑Guided Spatio‑Temporal Dispatcher (PG‑STD): PG‑STD acts as a feature dispatcher that route input frames to three parallel streams (preceding, succeeding, current frames) to prevent scene-cut contamination.
blocks.zh: PG-Guided Spatio 临时调度器(PG-STD):PG-STD充当一个功能调度器,将路由输入帧连接到三个平行流(前,后,当前帧),以防止场景被切割污染.

blocks.en: Bidirectional Temporal Feature Extraction (BTFE): Unlike single-stream methods, BTFE employs a dual-stream architecture with cross-connections to adaptively prioritize reliable temporal contexts, avoiding explicit scene detection.
blocks.zh: 双向时间特征提取(BTFE): 与单流方法不同,BTFE采用了双流结构,具有交叉连接,以适应性地优先安排可靠的时间背景,避免明显的场景探测.

blocks.en: Cascaded Multi-scale Feature Distillation (CMFD): To preserve fine details, CMFD employs a multi-branch architecture with multi-scale convolutions and channel attention mechanisms to distll multi-scale details in order to capture text strokes and structures while reducing over-smoothing.
blocks.zh: 叠加式多尺寸地物蒸馏(CMFD): 为了保存精细的细节,CMFD采用了多分支架构,具有多尺度的演化,并引导注意力机制来分解多尺度的细节,以便捕捉文字中风和结构,同时减少过度的流畅.

blocks.en: Finally, there is a reconstruction process to integrate BTFE and CMFD features via residual fusion for enhanced SCV output with stable gradients. Experimental results demonstrate that STM-Net achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, particularly in scenarios involving rich text and scene changes.
blocks.zh: 最后,有一个重建过程,通过剩余聚变将BTFE和CMFD的特性整合起来,用于增强具有稳定梯度的SCV输出. 实验结果表明,与最先进的方法相比,STM-Net取得了优异的性能,特别是在涉及丰富文本和场景变化的情景中。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , the overall framework can be summarized as comprising three main modules: PG-STD, BTFE, and CMFD.

blocks.en: II-A Prior-Guided Spatio-Temporal Dispatcher (PG-STD)
blocks.zh: II-A 事先指导的空间-时空调度员(PG-STD)

blocks.en: Unlike prior single-stream methods that risk feature contamination across scene switches, the proposed PG‑STD employs three parallel streams that process complementary temporal and spatial contexts to handle rapid changes in screen content. One stream processes the current frame with preceding frames { I t − 2 L ​ Q , I t − 1 L ​ Q , I t L ​ Q } \{I_{t-2}^{LQ},I_{t-1}^{LQ},I_{t}^{LQ}\} , another processes succeeding frames { I t L ​ Q , I t + 1 L ​ Q , I t + 2 L ​ Q } \{I_{t}^{LQ},I_{t+1}^{LQ},I_{t+2}^{LQ}\} , and a third stream operates on the current frame alone, I t L ​ Q I_{t}^{LQ} . The first two streams are fed into BTFE as dual parallel cross-connected streams that process different temporal input contexts to address rapid changes in screen content. These streams interconnect through a series of Residual Blocks (RBs) that extract hierarchical features by leveraging temporal dependencies through cross-connections. The single‑frame stream is fed into CMFD module to preserve fine spatial details and mitigate over‑smoothing.

blocks.en: III Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 三. 实验结果

blocks.en: III-A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 三.A 执行细节

blocks.en:
We constructed a dataset of 41 SCV sequences (28 for training, 13 for testing), including standard Common Test Condition (CTC) sequences [ 28 ] , SCVs from other sources, and self-captured SCVs containing abrupt motions [ 25 , 29 , 30 ] . Videos were encoded using the reference software HM16.20-SCM8.8 under the Low Delay Main SCC (LDMS) configuration at QPs 22, 27, 32, and 37.
The model was implemented in PyTorch and trained using the Charbonnier loss with the Adam optimizer (lr= 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) [ 31 ] for 300,000 iterations.
blocks.zh:
我们构建了41个SCV序列(28个用于培训,13个用于测试)的数据集,包括标准通用测试条件序列[28],其他来源的SCV,以及含有突然运动的自捕式SCV[25,29,30]. 视频在QPs 22,27,32和37的低延迟主SCC(LDMS)配置下使用参考软件HM16.20-SCM8.8编码.
该模型在PyTorch实施,并使用Charbonnier损失与亚当优化器(lr=10 – 4 10^{-4})[31]进行训练,共30万次迭代.

blocks.en: III-B Objective Visual Quality Analysis
blocks.zh: 目标视觉质量分析

blocks.en: We compare STM-Net against state-of-the-art methods, including STDF-R3 [ 14 ] , QECF [ 15 ] , CF-STIF [ 22 ] , and STDR [ 23 ] . As shown in Table I , STM-Net consistently achieves superior performance across all QP levels. At the highest compression (QP=37), STM-Net yields a Δ \Delta PSNR of 0.875 dB, surpassing the second-best methods (TGAF and CF-STIF) by approximately 8.3–9.4% and significantly outperforming STDF-R3 by 38.5%. These gains are sustained at lower QPs. Furthermore, STM-Net achieves a BD-rate reduction of − 7.12 % -7.12\% , representing a substantial improvement over CF-STIF ( − 6.48 % -6.48\% ). Scaling up to STM-Net-L with more RB and MSFDB blocks further improves the BD-rate reduction to − 7.46 % -7.46\% . Visual comparisons in Fig. 3 confirm that STM-Net restores sharper edges and clearer text, validating its specialized design for screen content.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了STM-Net与最先进的方法,包括STDF-R3 [14],QECF [15],CF-STIF [22],以及STDR [23]. 如表一所示,STM-Net在所有质量控制级别上一贯取得优异业绩。 在最高压缩(QP=37)时,STM-Net的产量为 \\Delta PSNR 0.875 dB,超过第二最佳方法(TGAF和CF-STIF)约8.3–9.4%,并且显著超过STDF-R338.5%。 这些进展在低质保中得以维持。 此外,STM-Net实现了-7.12%-7.12\%的BD比降幅,比CF-STIF(-6.48%-6.48\%)大有改善。 以更多的RB和MSFDB块扩大STM-Net-L,进一步将BD比降幅提高到-7.46%-7.46\%。 Fig. 3中的视觉比较证实,STM-Net恢复了更锋利的边缘和更清晰的文本,验证了它对于屏幕内容的专门设计.

blocks.en: To evaluate the capability of our proposed STM-Net in handling scene switches, a screen content videos was selected to compute the Δ \Delta PSNR curves for STDF-R3, QECF, CAT, CF-STIF, STDR, and our proposed method. The mixvideo sequence is composed of spliced videos from CTC [ 28 ] , which allows us to evaluate the performance of our method in scenarios involving abrupt scene transitions. The results are shown in Fig. 2 , where dashed lines indicate scene switch frames. The result demonstrates that our proposed method demonstrates an improvement during most of the transition points, highlighting its effectiveness in handling abrupt scene transitions. This robustness to screen content videos highlights the versatility and reliability of our method.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们提议的STM-Net处理场景开关的能力,选择了一张屏幕内容视频,以计算STDF-R3、QECF、CAT、CF-STIF、STDR和我们的拟议方法。 mixvideo 序列由来自CTC [28] 的成片视频组成,这使我们能够在涉及场景突变的情景中评价我们方法的性能. 结果以图2显示,其中虚线表示场景切换帧. 结果显示,我们提议的方法表明,大多数过渡点都有改进,突出了它在处理场景突然过渡方面的效力。 这种对内容视频进行筛选的强烈性凸显了我们方法的多功能性和可靠性.

blocks.en: III-C Subjective Visual Quality Analysis
blocks.zh: III-C 主观视觉质量分析

blocks.en: Fig. 3 presents a visual comparison at QP=37. The top and bottom rows display the Sephora and ChineseEditing sequences, which contain small-sized text and computer-graphic icon, respectively. This is a challenging case where high-frequency information is heavily quantized. While competing methods produce blurry artifacts in regions containing text, STM-Net effectively reconstructs the character shapes. This capability is directly attributed to the CMFD module, where the 1 × \times 1 convolution branch preserves fine details that are often lost by larger receptive fields.
blocks.zh: 图3在QP=37时呈现视觉对比. 上行和下行分别显示Sephora和ChineseEditing序列,它们分别包含小型文本和计算机图形图标. 这是一个具有挑战性的案例,高频信息被大量量化。 虽然相互竞争的方法在包含文字的区域产生模糊的文物,但STM-Net有效地重建了人物形状. 这种能力直接归功于CMFD模块,其中1××\time 1 演化分支保存了往往被更大的可接受域丢失的精细细节.

blocks.en: III-D Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 三-D 读取研究

blocks.en: To verify the contribution of each architectural component, we conducted ablation experiments at QP=37, with the results summarized in Table II . Specifically, we compare the full model STM-Net (baseline with the complete architecture) against three ablated variants: STM-Nscale , which removes the multi-scale feature extraction paths (5 × \times 5+CA and 3 × \times 3+CA branches); STM-NHF , which removes the high-frequency processing paths (1 × \times 1 + ReLU paths); and STM-Net-S , which reduces the network depth by using only 2 RB pairs and 2 MSFDBs.
blocks.zh: 为了核实每个建筑部分的贡献,我们在QP=37进行了消化试验,结果摘要见表二。 具体来说,我们比较了完整的模型STM-Net(基线与完整的架构)与三个被减速的变体: STM-Nscale ,它去除了多尺度的特性提取路径(5 × Times 5+ CA和3 × Times 3+ CA分支); STM-NHF,它去除了高频处理路径(1 × Times 1 + ReLU路径); 和 STM-Net-S,它只使用2 RB对和2 MSFDB来降低网络深度.

blocks.en: Impact of Multi-scale and High-frequency Processing: Eliminating the multi-scale branches (STM-Nscale) or discarding the high-frequency 1 × \times 1+ReLU paths (STM-NHF) both cause a consistent performance decrease of about 0.04 dB. This confirms that the multi-scale context modeling (via 5 × \times 5+CA and 3 × \times 3+CA) and the fine-grained high-frequency enhancement (via 1 × \times 1+ReLU) are complementary and jointly important for handling SCVs.
blocks.zh: 多规模和高频处理的影响: 消除多尺度分支(STM-Nscale)或丢弃高频1×\time 1+RELU路径(STM-NHF),两者都导致持续性能下降约0.04 dB. 这证实了多尺度上下文建模(通过5×时+CA和3×时+CA)和细纹高频增强(通过1×时+时+ReLU)是互补的,对处理SCV具有共同的重要性.

blocks.en: Impact of Network Depth: Among all variants, reducing the overall depth (STM-Net-S: 2 RB pairs and 2 MSFDBs) yields the largest degradation (-0.077 dB). This suggests that sufficient depth is crucial for both BTFE and CMFD modules to learn complex temporal and spatial dependencies respectively, which are important for robust processing under scene switches and fine-grained high-frequency details.
blocks.zh: 网络深度的影响:在所有变体中,降低整体深度(STM-Net-S:2RB对和2MSFDB)产生最大的降解(-0.077 dB). 这表明,对于BTFE模块和CMFD模块而言,充分深度对分别学习复杂的时间和空间依赖关系至关重要,这对于在场景开关和精细的高频细节下进行有力的处理十分重要。

blocks.en: III-E Model Scaling
blocks.zh: 三-E 模型缩放

blocks.en: Table III compares the average Δ \Delta PSNR against the model parameters. These results are averaged over all test sequences. As a result, the performance of STM-Net significantly surpasses other methods and requires fewer model parameters than CF-STIF and STDR, as in Table III . In addition, our STM-Net is a modular network, allowing for easy model scaling by varying the number of RB and MSFDB blocks. Therefore, in applications with computational limitations, we can use a lightweight structure, such as STM-Net-S, with fewer blocks ( N = M = 2 N=M=2 ). STM-Net-S requires fewer model parameters than STDF-R3, QECF, CAT, and STDR, as shown in Table III , yet still achieves higher Δ \Delta PSNR of 0.798 dB. This highlights the efficiency and effectiveness of our proposed method. On the other hand, scaling up as STM-Net-L ( N = M = 4 N=M=4 ) yields further improvements of nearly 1 dB (0.949 dB), which demonstrates that model scaling is applicable for our STM-Net on SCV enhancement.
blocks.zh: 表三将平均值 QQ\Delta PSNR与模型参数进行比较. 这些结果在所有测试序列中均值. 因此,与表三所示的CF-STIF和STDR相比,STTM-Net的性能大大超过了其他方法,需要较少的模型参数. 此外,我们的STM-Net是一个模块化网络,能够通过改变RB和MSFDB区块的数量来方便模型的缩放. 因此,在有计算局限性的应用中,我们可以使用一个轻量级结构,如STM-Net-S,其区块较少(N=M=2 N=M=2). 如表三所示,STF-R3、QECF、CAT和STDR需要较少的模型参数,但仍能达到0.798 dB的更高水平。 这突出表明了我们拟议方法的效率和效力。 另一方面,随着STM-Net-L(N = M = 4 N = M = 4)的扩大,则进一步提高了近1 dB(0.949 dB),这表明模型的扩大适用于我们在SCV上的改进。

blocks.en: III-F Feature Visualizations
blocks.zh: III-F 特性可视化

blocks.en: Fig. 4 presents intermediate feature visualizations for BTFE and CMFD using Grad-CAM [ 32 ] , which validates their key advantages. These features illustrate how BTFE’s dual-stream design automatically prioritizes the more temporally consistent direction during abrupt scene switches, while CMFD effectively preserves sharp text strokes and high-frequency details. In BTFE visualizations, light colors indicate high activation weights assigned to the more temporally consistent stream (reliable frames), while dark colors denote suppressed weights on disrupted streams during abrupt scene switches, which demonstrates automatic prioritization without explicit detection. Meanwhile, CMFD features (right) preserve sharp text strokes and high-frequency details through multi-scale distillation, with light-to-dark gradients highlighting enhanced edge recovery and reduced over-smoothing compared to inputs.
blocks.zh: 图4为BTFE和CMFD提供了中间特性可视化,使用Grad-CAM[32],验证了它们的关键优势. 这些功能说明了BTFE双流设计如何在突发场景开关时自动排列时间上更一致的方向,而CMFD则有效地保留了尖锐的文字中风和高频细节. 在BTFE可视化中,浅色表示分配给时间较为一致的溪流(可靠框架)的高激活重量,而暗色表示突发场景切换时对中断的溪流的压制重量,这显示出在没有明确检测的情况下自动排列优先次序. 同时,CMFD的特征(右)通过多尺度的蒸馏来保持尖锐的文字中风和高频细节,光到暗的梯度突出增强的边缘恢复,与输入相比减少过沉.

blocks.en: IV Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四. 结论

blocks.en: This paper presents STM-Net, a specialized framework for screen content video quality enhancement. By seamlessly integrating Prior-Guided Spatio-Temporal Dispatcher (PG-STD), bidirectional temporal feature extraction (BTFE) with cascaded multi-scale feature distillation (CMFD), it effectively tackles SCV-specific challenges such as abrupt scene switches, discontinuous motions, and high-frequency detail loss from compression artifacts. Extensive experiments confirm that STM-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance, offering a promising solution for high-quality screen content delivery.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍STM-Net,是屏幕内容视频质量提升的专门框架. 通过无缝融合了前导的Spatio-Temporal调度器(PG-STD),双向时间特征提取器(BTFE)与级联的多级特征蒸馏器(CMFD),有效地解决了SCV特有的挑战,如场景开关突然,不连续运动,以及压缩文物产生的高频细节损失. 广泛的实验证实,STM-Net实现了最先进的性能,为高质量的屏幕内容提供提供了一个很有希望的解决办法。
